description.value: Viti Wine and Lager is a multi-location BC liquor retailer with five Lower Mainland stores, part of the award-winning Viaggi Hospitality group. The Hastings location anchors East Vancouver's main commercial strip, offering wine, lager, gift cards, and custom orders. It is a convenient resupply stop for touring cyclists riding the East Hastings corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at vitiwinelagers.com/hastings confirms this is a real, active Hastings location of the Viti Wine and Lager chain, with address 3519 East Hastings Street Vancouver BC V5K 0A3 and phone 604.299.0702 matching OSM exactly. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website. The OSM opening_hours tag does not match the hours listed on the website for this location, suggesting the OSM hours entry is outdated.
